title: Ruben Probable NDE 5026
content: I am afraid of needles and blood and as a result can get dizzy or faint. That time was very different. I was counting numbers in order to relax and suddenly I felt the needle. Without me thinking about it the numbers were going by faster, I disappeared. I did not feel my body. Everything was black with colored spheres turning, and what sounded like music (although this I don't remember too well). I felt vibrations. I am not sure whether the music was there or whether I was imagining it. I felt very well. The truth is that I did not ask myself what I was doing there. Suddenly I felt a strange pain and a headache. I had woken up and the doctors where giving me air. I asked how long I had been unconscious and they said approximately six seconds but it felt to me like it was much longer. The experience felt both long and short in duration. It was a very strange feeling. I would have liked to have stayed there longer. I felt a distorted sense of time when I woke up.

elements.At what time during the experience were: I am not sure that I was conscious. I could speak to myself but said nothing. Inside I felt as though many voices were speaking to me but it did not bother me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was unconscious for six seconds but it felt like much longer, although at the same time it happened very quickly.

elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Not everything was good like many people say. I did not feel well, but at the same time, nothing hurt. At the same time, I felt peaceful. I did not know why I was there nor did I care.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will

elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real I am sure that it was real, perhaps my brain created those images. Does that mean it's not real?
